data.title: PR 18 replay validation: every reduced core is checked to fail through the original causal mechanism (typed rejections, validator-gated candidate keeping)

data.body:
[risk:high] Cross-epoch labels can be accepted as the original causal mechanism.

`chains` groups submissions by node and value only. It never requires the submission epoch to match the acknowledged epoch (lines 677-734). The generated guard also lets any epoch-specific `Lose` end the no-`Sync` interval because `loses_of` enumerates both epochs (lines 842-845, used at lines 894-900). Thus a two-epoch story can derive or validate an `Ack(epoch=0)` mechanism using `Submit` or `Lose(epoch=1)`. A later `Sync(epoch=0)` can be hidden behind that unrelated loss. `Target::offending` is explicitly per epoch at lines 54-74. This can return `Preserved` after the actual witness mechanism is gone.

Failure modes: Wrong-epoch submissions justify an acknowledgement. Unrelated losses terminate guards. A reduced core loses the actual witness but remains `Validated`.
Edge cases: Repeated values across epochs, interleaved crashes, epoch-drop renaming, and same-node writes in both epochs.
Rollback: Limit this validator to one epoch, or revert it until epoch identity is bound.
Monitoring: Reject or count mechanisms whose `Ack`, `Submit`, `Sync`, and `Lose` fields disagree on epoch.
Validation: Add two-epoch mutants with cross-epoch `Submit` or `Lose`, plus a later same-epoch `Sync`. Require `MissingStep` or `GuardBroken`, never `Preserved`.

data.reason: risk:high th-2q3qcy: mechanism derivation and guards omit epoch binding, so a two-epoch replay can be validated through cross-epoch Submit, Lose, or Sync labels.

data.body: Fixed in d2d2faa0. chains() now reads only Submit, Lose and Sync labels in the acknowledgement's epoch. The later Agreement acknowledgement must also be in that epoch. chain_mechanism refuses a step whose label names no epoch or another epoch. Every guard's forbidden and until labels name only that epoch. Cross-epoch durability does not count: the durable register keeps one slot per replica and epoch (durable_of, Target::offending, the observer's slot keys), so a Sync of another epoch is another slot's durability. It neither breaks nor ends a guard. A dropped epoch renames to epoch=dropped and never matches. Test: pr18_impl03_mechanism.rs::cross_epoch_labels_never_satisfy_a_step_or_clear_a_guard. Two-epoch replays with a's Submit, the Lose, or the later Ack only in epoch 1 are rejected MissingStep and derive no chain. An epoch-1 Lose before an epoch-0 Sync is GuardBroken. Epoch-1 Sync and Submit leave the guards alone. Labels with no epoch derive nothing. Positive control: both M01 witnesses and all 400 corpus cores still validate. The impl01 and impl02 goldens are unchanged, and the impl03 golden changes only in check work units. The test is in the review record. just check: only security-review-present fails (lead-owned). No conflict markers.

Verified at 02eb106f. The epoch filter covers Submit, Lose, Sync, and later Agreement Ack labels. Epoch-specific guards and the cross-epoch regression test now fail closed. The full 11-test mechanism suite, including all 400 corpus cores, passes.

data.reason: Fixed in d2d2faa0 and verified at target 02eb106f
Whole persisted range reviewed at 02eb106f. No unresolved security findings. The repaired epoch binding fails closed, and the debugger plus full PR18 mechanism suites pass.
